title: SE16N
tagline: Browse and filter table content in your browser: the classic SE16N as an abap2UI5 app.
summary: se16n is an abap2UI5 app that shows the content of any table: enter a table name, narrow the selection with select-options for every field, pick a saved layout and see the result as a table whose columns you can rearrange and save as a layout. It runs on ABAP Cloud, where there is no SE16N, as well as on premise. The selection comes from the selection-screen addon and the result table and its layouts from layout-management. It is a developer tool without authorization checks of its own, so add your own before using it beyond a development system.
features: Table name input with select-options for all fields and saved variants
Choose Layout picks a layout saved earlier for the table
Result table of at most 100 rows; layout popup for columns, order, labels, sorting
Runs on ABAP Cloud and on premise
Compact example of how selection-screen and layout-management fit together
requirements: ABAP Cloud (S/4 Public Cloud, BTP ABAP Environment), S/4 Private Cloud or On-Premise, or NetWeaver 7.50 or higher

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: 1. abap2UI5, 2. layout-management, 3. selection-screen, 4. this repository (branch main)
Add authorization checks (e.g. S_TABU_DIS / S_TABU_NAM) before opening it to other users
